_comment: TestGen settings (hook .claude/hooks/testgen.mts, skill TestGen, tool tools/testgen/testgen.mts).
_hallucination_tolerance_comment: Number of unverifiable facts allowed in a run. 0 = every screen, element, navigation step and cited source must be found in the DSM, AUT skills, code model, locator files, domain skill or fetched requirements.
_comment_require_report_fields: When true, every test case carries the Manual Test Case Report fields: severity, sub_module, one-word feature, channel, coverage and test_data.
